source_read: https://www.auntieannes.co.uk/menu/ (menu page, menu sitemap and all 127 item pages /menu/<slug>/, downloaded 2026-10-08 at one request per second with a browser User-Agent; robots.txt is 'User-agent: *, Disallow:' (nothing disallowed)). The Allergens tab of every option is what the chain prints; no other source was used.
notes: Independent read: every one of the 127 pages was loaded live in headless Chromium (page's own JavaScript), every size/count/type button was clicked and the Allergens tab the page then shows was read from the DOM (visible labels and icon file names, which must agree with each other), not from the script's variantData parse. All 143 option rows that have a row in allergens.csv (130 published + 13 held back for their numbers) match exactly (0 mismatches); all 14 allergens occur in the compared rows; 6 rows print 'None' (Firecracker, Marinara and Sweet Chilli dips; Raspberry Sorbet Gelato) and are published as 'contains none of the 14'; 3 tabs were also screenshotted and looked at (BBQ Chicken Pizza, Cheese Pretzel Dog, Firecracker Dip). The page prints no 'may contain' information (may_contain_published = no) and names no cereal or nut. Held back (40 items, holdback.csv): the Two Scoops and Three Scoops options of all 20 gelato flavours. Their data has NO allergens key/value (the script reads None), and allergens are never copied from another option. FINDING: on the live page, clicking Two or Three Scoops leaves the previous option's allergen panel on screen (the page's JavaScript calls jQuery .html(undefined), which does nothing), so a visitor sees the One Scoop allergens under those sizes; the page's data itself holds none. To publish them anyway, copy the One Scoop row (founder's call, it is an inference) - delete the lines from holdback.csv and make aunties_anne.py read them from One Scoop. Judgement calls kept as printed: BBQ Chicken Pizza and BBQ Meat Feast Pizza (both sizes) print all 14 allergens (over-warning, not a wrong 'safe' row) while Chicken, Spicy Chicken and Farmhouse pizzas print only gluten/milk(/sulphites) - the pages differ and nothing was inferred; BBQ Dip prints 13 (all but gluten). Margherita, Farmhouse and Vegetarian pizza print identical nutrition but different allergens (Farmhouse and Vegetarian add sulphites) - copied as printed. Audit: 2 medium flags (Mango Sorbet and Raspberry Sorbet Gelato, one scoop: 'gelato' without milk; both pages print the Vegan flag) logged ok in data/audit/reviewed/aunties-anne.csv. A re-run on the same day reproduced identical nutrition numbers (compared id by id: 0 differences); only the row order follows the site's re-written sitemap and chain.csv/allergen_guide.csv carry checked_on 2026-10-08. check_chain.py aunties-anne --fail-on-high: 0 errors, 0 warnings, 0 high / 0 medium flags; built chain has 130 items, all with allergens, allergenGuide.complete = true. The older verified/aunties-anne.json (nutrition) still says the chain gets the guide link only: that is now out of date.
